bio.sourceLabel: In his own words on the page MAJI Party publishes about him — majiparty.org, read 2026-08-24

hunt.note: RULING 122 (Sean's decision of 2026-08-24, closing NH11): Fife has no campaign domain and no campaign social page; his only public presence is the candidate page his party publishes. Sean ruled it counts as his verified page AND his contact, labelled party-hosted. Re-walked live at rung 2 on 2026-08-24: HTTP 200, 225,889 bytes, control strings 'Shaun Fife' x4 / 'Governor' x2 / the address x2, negative control 0. The words are quoted verbatim from that page and the address is a real mailto: on it (mailto:Action4NH@gmail.com). The blurb carries the PARTY as its source class rather than 'the campaign', because that is whose page it is — a description without its true source class is treated as a generated claim.
